explanation: The statement is entirely about library-specific objects: `TauCeti.E6DoubledMinuscule.rationalSerreRepresentation` (defined in this very file as `TauCeti.serreLift isSerreSystemQ`) and `raisingMatrixQ` (defined as `matrixIntCastLieHom ℚ (raisingMatrix i)` over the E6 doubled-minuscule weight table). The proof applies `TauCeti.serreLift_serreE` (TauCeti.Algebra.Lie.Presentation.Serre, line 432) together with the general pattern of Serre systems `TauCeti.IsSerreSystem` — both declarations of this library, not of Mathlib. I searched Mathlib for the underlying machinery: `Algebra/Lie/SerreConstruction.lean` only defines `CartanMatrix.Generators`, the Serre relations and `Matrix.ToLieAlgebra` as a quotient, with no generator projections, no `IsSerreSystem`/universal-property lift (`serreLift`) and hence no lemma of the form `lift (E_i) = E i` (grep for `serreE`, `serreLift`, `IsSerreSystem`, `liftQ` in Lie files gives nothing). Also no `raisingMatrix`, `loweringMatrix`, `cartanGenerator`, `rationalSerreRepresentation` or any matrix weight-table representation exists in Mathlib. The remaining candidates such as `IsSl2Triple` lemmas concern the abstract triple, not this identification. Hence no duplicate and no single-declaration special case.
